title: Model Arena lab
description: A GWTH lab: one realistic task, two AI models run head-to-head on the same prompt, outputs shown verbatim side by side, a beginner rubric, and a dated verdict. Deliberately perishable; superseded when models change. See MODEL_ARENA_TEMPLATE.md.

format.description: Discriminates this from the retired tiered-lab format.

title.description: Plain and specific: the task, then the matchup.

status.description: live = one of the ~6 current labs; archived = superseded but kept for the archive.

category.description: Broad task area, e.g. Writing, HR, Research, Admin.

testedOn.description: The date both outputs were generated (ISO yyyy-mm-dd).

brief.description: One paragraph: who the student pretends to be, the realistic task, why it matters. Plain English.

name.description: Friendly product name, e.g. Claude, ChatGPT.

modelId.description: Exact model id, never rounded, e.g. claude-opus-4-8, gpt-5.6-sol.

modelLabel.description: Human model label, e.g. Claude Opus 4.8.

howRun.description: Exactly how it was run, e.g. Codex CLI 0.144.1 at high reasoning effort.

prompt.description: The single prompt given to BOTH models, verbatim and identical.

outputs.description: Each contestant's real answer, quoted verbatim. Same order as matchup.

verbatim.description: The output exactly as generated. Never edited, trimmed or paraphrased.

rubric.description: 4-6 criteria a beginner can score by reading.

criterion.description: A plain question the student answers for each output.

goodLooksLike.description: One line on what a strong answer looks like.

winner.description: Contestant name, or 'Close' / 'Tie'. Honest, never rigged.

callText.description: The reasoned verdict, fair to the loser.

freshnessNote.description: Reminder that models change, so this holds only for these versions and this date.

tryItYourself.description: Short numbered steps for the student to run the same task themselves.
